verses.original: דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיְהִ֥י אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh way·hî ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֔ם הֲתִשְׁפֹּ֥ט הֲתִשְׁפֹּ֖ט אֶת־ עִ֣יר הַדָּמִ֑ים וְה֣וֹדַעְתָּ֔הּ אֵ֖ת כָּל־ תּוֹעֲבוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām hă·ṯiš·pōṭ hă·ṯiš·pōṭ ’eṯ- ‘îr had·dā·mîm wə·hō·w·ḏa‘·tāh ’êṯ kāl- tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: As for you son of man will you judge her Will you pass judgment - on the city of bloodshed Then confront her - with all her abominations

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ עִ֣יר עִתָּ֑הּ לָב֣וֹא שֹׁפֶ֥כֶת דָּ֛ם בְּתוֹכָ֖הּ וְעָשְׂתָ֧ה גִלּוּלִ֛ים עָלֶ֖יהָ לְטָמְאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ‘îr ‘it·tāh lā·ḇō·w šō·p̄e·ḵeṯ dām bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh wə·‘ā·śə·ṯāh ḡil·lū·lîm ‘ā·le·hā lə·ṭā·mə·’āh
verses.literal: and tell her that this is what the Lord GOD says O city who brings her own doom . . . by shedding blood within her walls and making idols vvv to defile herself

verses.original: אָשַׁ֗מְתְּ בְּדָמֵ֨ךְ אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁפַ֜כְתְּ טָמֵ֔את וּבְגִלּוּלַ֤יִךְ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂית֙ יָמַ֔יִךְ וַתַּקְרִ֣יבִי וַתָּב֖וֹא עַד־ שְׁנוֹתָ֑יִךְ עַל־ כֵּ֗ן נְתַתִּ֤יךְ חֶרְפָּה֙ לַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְקַלָּסָ֖ה לְכָל־ הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·šamt bə·ḏā·mêḵ ’ă·šer- šā·p̄aḵt ṭā·mêṯ ū·ḇə·ḡil·lū·la·yiḵ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śîṯ yā·ma·yiḵ wat·taq·rî·ḇî wat·tā·ḇō·w ‘aḏ- šə·nō·w·ṯā·yiḵ ‘al- kên nə·ṯat·tîḵ ḥer·pāh lag·gō·w·yim wə·qal·lā·sāh lə·ḵāl hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: you are guilty of the blood - you have shed and you are defiled by the idols - you have made You have brought your days to a close and have come to [the] [end] [of] your years Therefore . . . I have made you a reproach to the nations and a mockery to all the lands

verses.original: הַקְּרֹב֛וֹת וְהָרְחֹק֥וֹת מִמֵּ֖ךְ יִתְקַלְּסוּ־ בָ֑ךְ טְמֵאַ֣ת הַשֵּׁ֔ם רַבַּ֖ת הַמְּהוּמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: haq·qə·rō·ḇō·wṯ wə·hā·rə·ḥō·qō·wṯ mim·mêḵ yiṯ·qal·lə·sū- ḇāḵ ṭə·mê·’aṯ haš·šêm rab·baṯ ham·mə·hū·māh
verses.literal: Those near and far - will mock you O infamous [city] . . . full of turmoil

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ אִ֥ישׁ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָ֑ךְ הָ֣יוּ לִזְרֹע֖וֹ לְמַ֖עַן שְׁפָךְ־ דָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’îš nə·śî·’ê yiś·rā·’êl ḇāḵ hā·yū liz·rō·‘ōw lə·ma·‘an šə·p̄āḵ- dām
verses.literal: See how every prince of Israel within you has used his power to shed blood

verses.original: אָ֤ב וָאֵם֙ הֵקַ֣לּוּ בָ֔ךְ לַגֵּ֛ר עָשׂ֥וּ בַעֹ֖שֶׁק בְּתוֹכֵ֑ךְ יָת֥וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֖ה ה֥וֹנוּ בָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’āḇ wā·’êm hê·qal·lū ḇāḵ lag·gêr ‘ā·śū ḇa·‘ō·šeq bə·ṯō·w·ḵêḵ yā·ṯō·wm wə·’al·mā·nāh hō·w·nū ḇāḵ
verses.literal: Father and mother are treated with contempt Within your walls the foreign resident is exploited . . . - the fatherless and the widow are oppressed

verses.original: בָּזִ֑ית קָדָשַׁ֖י וְאֶת־ חִלָּֽלְתְּ׃ שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖י
verses.transliteration: bā·zîṯ qā·ḏā·šay wə·’eṯ- ḥil·lā·lət šab·bə·ṯō·ṯay
verses.literal: You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths

verses.original: בָ֖ךְ הָ֥יוּ רָכִ֛יל אַנְשֵׁ֥י לְמַ֣עַן שְׁפָךְ־ דָּ֑ם בָ֔ךְ אָ֣כְלוּ וְאֶל־ הֶֽהָרִים֙ עָשׂ֥וּ זִמָּ֖ה בְתוֹכֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ḇāḵ hā·yū rā·ḵîl ’an·šê lə·ma·‘an šə·p̄āḵ- dām ḇāḵ ’ā·ḵə·lū wə·’el- he·hā·rîm ‘ā·śū zim·māh ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵêḵ
verses.literal: Among you are slanderous men bent on - bloodshed within you are those who eat on the mountain [shrines] and commit acts of indecency -

verses.original: בָ֑ךְ גִּלָּה־ עֶרְוַת־ אָ֖ב בָֽךְ׃ עִנּוּ־ טְמֵאַ֥ת הַנִּדָּ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ḇāḵ gil·lāh- ‘er·waṯ- ’āḇ ḇāḵ ‘in·nū- ṭə·mê·’aṯ han·nid·dāh
verses.literal: In you they have uncovered the nakedness of their fathers in you they violate women during their menstrual impurity . . .

verses.original: וְאִ֣ישׁ׀ עָשָׂה֙ תּֽוֹעֵבָ֔ה אֶת־ רֵעֵ֗הוּ אֵ֣שֶׁת וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ בְזִמָּ֑ה טִמֵּ֣א כַּלָּת֖וֹ וְאִ֛ישׁ אֶת־ עִנָּה־ בָֽךְ׃ אֲחֹת֥וֹ אָבִ֖יו בַת־
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ‘ā·śāh tō·w·‘ê·ḇāh ’eṯ- rê·‘ê·hū ’ê·šeṯ wə·’îš ’eṯ- ḇə·zim·māh ṭim·mê kal·lā·ṯōw wə·’îš ’eṯ- ‘in·nāh- ḇāḵ ’ă·ḥō·ṯōw ’ā·ḇîw ḇaṯ-
verses.literal: One man commits an abomination with his neighbor’s wife another - wickedly defiles his daughter-in-law and yet another - violates his sister his own father’s daughter

verses.original: בָ֖ךְ לָֽקְחוּ־ שֹׁ֥חַד לְמַ֣עַן שְׁפָךְ־ דָּ֑ם לָקַ֗חַתְּ נֶ֧שֶׁךְ וַתְּבַצְּעִ֤י וְתַרְבִּ֣ית בַּעֹ֔שֶׁק רֵעַ֙יִךְ֙ וְאֹתִ֣י שָׁכַ֔חַתְּ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḇāḵ lā·qə·ḥū- šō·ḥaḏ lə·ma·‘an šə·p̄āḵ- dām lā·qa·ḥat ne·šeḵ wat·tə·ḇaṣ·ṣə·‘î wə·ṯar·bîṯ ba·‘ō·šeq rê·‘a·yiḵ wə·’ō·ṯî šā·ḵa·ḥat nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: In you they take bribes to shed blood You engage in usury take excess interest and extort your neighbors But Me you have forgotten declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֙ הִכֵּ֣יתִי כַפִּ֔י אֶל־ בִּצְעֵ֖ךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑ית וְעַ֨ל־ דָּמֵ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ בְּתוֹכֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh hik·kê·ṯî ḵap·pî ’el- biṣ·‘êḵ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śîṯ wə·‘al- dā·mêḵ ’ă·šer hā·yū bə·ṯō·w·ḵêḵ
verses.literal: Now look I strike My hands together against your unjust gain - - and against the blood you have shed - - in your midst

verses.original: לִבֵּךְ֙ הֲיַעֲמֹ֤ד אִם־ יָדַ֔יִךְ תֶּחֱזַ֣קְנָה לַיָּמִ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י עֹשֶׂ֣ה אוֹתָ֑ךְ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְעָשִֽׂיתִי׃
verses.transliteration: lib·bêḵ hă·ya·‘ă·mōḏ ’im- yā·ḏa·yiḵ te·ḥĕ·zaq·nāh lay·yā·mîm ’ă·šer ’ă·nî ‘ō·śeh ’ō·w·ṯāḵ ’ă·nî Yah·weh dib·bar·tî wə·‘ā·śî·ṯî
verses.literal: Will your courage endure or your hands be strong in the day - I deal with you I the LORD have spoken and I will act

verses.original: וַהֲפִיצוֹתִ֤י אוֹתָךְ֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וְזֵרִיתִ֖יךְ בָּאֲרָצ֑וֹת וַהֲתִמֹּתִ֥י טֻמְאָתֵ֖ךְ מִמֵּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·p̄î·ṣō·w·ṯî ’ō·w·ṯāḵ bag·gō·w·yim wə·zê·rî·ṯîḵ bā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ wa·hă·ṯim·mō·ṯî ṭum·’ā·ṯêḵ mim·mêḵ
verses.literal: I will disperse - you among the nations and scatter you throughout the lands I will purge your uncleanness . . .

verses.original: וְנִחַ֥לְתְּ בָּ֖ךְ לְעֵינֵ֣י גוֹיִ֑ם וְיָדַ֖עַתְּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ni·ḥalt bāḵ lə·‘ê·nê ḡō·w·yim wə·yā·ḏa·‘at kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: And when you have defiled yourself in the eyes of the nations then you will know that I am the LORD

verses.original: דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיְהִ֥י אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh way·hî ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם בֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הָיוּ־ לְסוּג לִ֥י כֻּלָּ֡ם נְ֠חֹשֶׁת וּבְדִ֨יל וּבַרְזֶ֤ל וְעוֹפֶ֙רֶת֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ כּ֔וּר הָיֽוּ׃ס סִגִ֥ים כֶּ֖סֶף
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl hā·yū- lə·sūḡ lî kul·lām nə·ḥō·šeṯ ū·ḇə·ḏîl ū·ḇar·zel wə·‘ō·w·p̄e·reṯ bə·ṯō·wḵ kūr hā·yū si·ḡîm ke·sep̄
verses.literal: Son of man the house of Israel has become dross to Me All of them are copper tin iron and lead inside the furnace they are but the dross of silver

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ יַ֛עַן כֻּלְּכֶ֖ם הֱי֥וֹת לְסִגִ֑ים לָכֵן֙ הִנְנִ֣י קֹבֵ֣ץ אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶל־ תּ֖וֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ya·‘an kul·lə·ḵem hĕ·yō·wṯ lə·si·ḡîm lā·ḵên hin·nî qō·ḇêṣ ’eṯ·ḵem ’el- tō·wḵ yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Because all of you have become dross vvv behold I will gather you into . . . Jerusalem

verses.original: קְבֻ֣צַת כֶּ֡סֶף וּ֠נְחֹשֶׁת וּבַרְזֶ֨ל וְעוֹפֶ֤רֶת וּבְדִיל֙ אֶל־ תּ֣וֹךְ כּ֔וּר לְהַנְתִּ֑יךְ אֵ֖שׁ לָפַֽחַת־ עָלָ֥יו כֵּ֤ן אֶקְבֹּץ֙ בְּאַפִּ֣י וּבַחֲמָתִ֔י וְהִנַּחְתִּ֥י וְהִתַּכְתִּ֖י אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: qə·ḇu·ṣaṯ ke·sep̄ ū·nə·ḥō·šeṯ ū·ḇar·zel wə·‘ō·w·p̄e·reṯ ū·ḇə·ḏîl ’el- tō·wḵ kūr lə·han·tîḵ ’êš lā·p̄a·ḥaṯ- ‘ā·lāw kên ’eq·bōṣ bə·’ap·pî ū·ḇa·ḥă·mā·ṯî wə·hin·naḥ·tî wə·hit·taḵ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: Just as one gathers silver copper iron lead and tin into . . . the furnace to melt with a fiery blast . . . so I will gather you in My anger and wrath leave [you] [there] and melt you

verses.original: וְכִנַּסְתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְנָפַחְתִּ֥י עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בְּאֵ֣שׁ עֶבְרָתִ֑י וְנִתַּכְתֶּ֖ם בְּתוֹכָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵin·nas·tî ’eṯ·ḵem wə·nā·p̄aḥ·tî ‘ă·lê·ḵem bə·’êš ‘eḇ·rā·ṯî wə·nit·taḵ·tem bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh
verses.literal: Yes, I will gather you together - and blow on you with the fire of My wrath and you will be melted within the city

verses.original: כֶּ֙סֶף֙ כְּהִתּ֥וּךְ בְּת֣וֹךְ כּ֔וּר כֵּ֖ן תֻּתְּכ֣וּ בְתוֹכָ֑הּ וִֽידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה שָׁפַ֥כְתִּי חֲמָתִ֖י עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ke·sep̄ kə·hit·tūḵ bə·ṯō·wḵ kūr kên tut·tə·ḵū ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵāh wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh šā·p̄aḵ·tî ḥă·mā·ṯî ‘ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: As silver is melted in a furnace so you will be melted within the city Then you will know that I the LORD have poured out My wrath upon you

verses.original: דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיְהִ֥י אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh way·hî ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the word of the LORD came to me saying

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם אֱמָר־ לָ֕הּ בְּי֥וֹם זָֽעַם׃ אַ֣תְּ אֶ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א מְטֹהָרָ֖ה הִ֑יא לֹ֥א גֻשְׁמָ֖הּ
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām ’ĕ·mār- lāh bə·yō·wm zā·‘am ’at ’e·reṣ lō mə·ṭō·hā·rāh hî lō ḡuš·māh
verses.literal: Son of man say to her In the day of indignation you are a land that has not been cleansed upon which . . . [no] rain has fallen

verses.original: קֶ֤שֶׁר נְבִיאֶ֙יהָ֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ שׁוֹאֵ֖ג כַּאֲרִ֥י טֹ֣רֵֽף טָ֑רֶף אָכָ֗לוּ נֶ֣פֶשׁ יִקָּ֔חוּ חֹ֤סֶן וִיקָר֙ הִרְבּ֥וּ אַלְמְנוֹתֶ֖יהָ בְתוֹכָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: qe·šer nə·ḇî·’e·hā bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh šō·w·’êḡ ka·’ă·rî ṭō·rêp̄ ṭā·rep̄ ’ā·ḵā·lū ne·p̄eš yiq·qā·ḥū ḥō·sen wî·qār hir·bū ’al·mə·nō·w·ṯe·hā ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵāh
verses.literal: The conspiracy of the princes in her midst is like a roaring lion tearing its prey They devour the people seize the treasures and precious things and multiply the widows within her

verses.original: כֹּהֲנֶ֜יהָ חָמְס֣וּ תוֹרָתִי֮ וַיְחַלְּל֣וּ קָדָשַׁי֒ לֹ֣א הִבְדִּ֔ילוּ בֵּֽין־ קֹ֤דֶשׁ לְחֹל֙ לֹ֣א הוֹדִ֑יעוּ וּבֵין־ לְטָה֖וֹר הַטָּמֵ֥א הֶעְלִ֣ימוּ עֵֽינֵיהֶ֔ם וּמִשַׁבְּתוֹתַי֙ וָאֵחַ֖ל בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kō·hă·ne·hā ḥā·mə·sū ṯō·w·rā·ṯî way·ḥal·lə·lū qā·ḏā·šay lō hiḇ·dî·lū bên- qō·ḏeš lə·ḥōl lō hō·w·ḏî·‘ū ū·ḇên- lə·ṭā·hō·wr haṭ·ṭā·mê he‘·lî·mū ‘ê·nê·hem ū·mi·šab·bə·ṯō·w·ṯay wā·’ê·ḥal bə·ṯō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: Her priests do violence to My law and profane My holy things They make no distinction between the holy and the common and they fail to distinguish between the clean and the unclean They disregard . . . My Sabbaths so that I am profaned among them

verses.original: שָׂרֶ֣יהָ בְקִרְבָּ֔הּ כִּזְאֵבִ֖ים טֹ֣רְפֵי טָ֑רֶף לִשְׁפָּךְ־ דָּם֙ לְאַבֵּ֣ד נְפָשׁ֔וֹת לְמַ֖עַן בְּצֹ֥עַ בָּֽצַע׃
verses.transliteration: śā·re·hā ḇə·qir·bāh kiz·’ê·ḇîm ṭō·rə·p̄ê ṭā·rep̄ liš·pāḵ- dām lə·’ab·bêḏ nə·p̄ā·šō·wṯ lə·ma·‘an bə·ṣō·a‘ bā·ṣa‘
verses.literal: Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey shedding blood and destroying lives for dishonest gain . . .

verses.original: וּנְבִיאֶ֗יהָ טָח֤וּ תָּפֵ֔ל לָהֶם֙ שָׁ֔וְא חֹזִ֣ים כָּזָ֑ב וְקֹסְמִ֥ים לָהֶ֖ם אֹמְרִ֗ים כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ וַֽיהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א דִבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ḇî·’e·hā ṭā·ḥū tā·p̄êl lā·hem šāw ḥō·zîm kā·zāḇ wə·qō·sə·mîm lā·hem ’ō·mə·rîm kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar Yah·weh lō ḏib·bêr
verses.literal: Her prophets vvv whitewash [these deeds] by false visions and lying divinations saying This is what the Lord GOD says when the LORD has not spoken

verses.original: עַ֤ם הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ עָ֣שְׁקוּ עֹ֔שֶׁק וְגָזְל֖וּ גָּזֵ֑ל הוֹנ֔וּ וְאֶת־ וְעָנִ֤י וְאֶבְיוֹן֙ עָשְׁק֖וּ הַגֵּ֥ר בְּלֹ֥א מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ ‘ā·šə·qū ‘ō·šeq wə·ḡā·zə·lū gā·zêl hō·w·nū wə·’eṯ- wə·‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn ‘ā·šə·qū hag·gêr bə·lō miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: The people of the land have practiced extortion and committed robbery . . . They have oppressed - the poor and needy and have exploited the foreign resident without justice

verses.original: וָאֲבַקֵּ֣שׁ אִ֣ישׁ מֵהֶ֡ם גֹּֽדֵר־ גָּדֵר֩ וְעֹמֵ֨ד בַּפֶּ֧רֶץ לְפָנַ֛י בְּעַ֥ד הָאָ֖רֶץ לְבִלְתִּ֣י שַׁחֲתָ֑הּ מָצָֽאתִי׃ וְלֹ֖א
verses.transliteration: wā·’ă·ḇaq·qêš ’îš mê·hem gō·ḏêr- gā·ḏêr wə·‘ō·mêḏ bap·pe·reṣ lə·p̄ā·nay bə·‘aḏ hā·’ā·reṣ lə·ḇil·tî ša·ḥă·ṯāh mā·ṣā·ṯî wə·lō
verses.literal: I searched for a man among them to repair the wall and stand in the gap before Me on behalf of the land so that I should not destroy it But I found no one

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁפֹּ֤ךְ זַעְמִ֔י עֲלֵיהֶם֙ כִּלִּיתִ֑ים בְּאֵ֥שׁ עֶבְרָתִ֖י נָתַ֔תִּי דַּרְכָּם֙ בְּרֹאשָׁ֣ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·pōḵ za‘·mî ‘ă·lê·hem kil·lî·ṯîm bə·’êš ‘eḇ·rā·ṯî nā·ṯat·tî dar·kām bə·rō·šām nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: So I have poured out My indignation upon them and consumed them with the fire of My fury I have brought their ways down upon their own heads declares the Lord GOD
